children: Parsa Kiai, a director, reported that Steamboat Capital Partners Master Fund, LP purchased 91,330 Medifast shares through November 18 and 19 transactions, and Steamboat Capital Partners II, LP purchased 2,706 shares through transactions on the same dates. On November 18, the funds purchased a combined 8,886 shares at $12.1613 per share; on November 19, they purchased a combined 85,150 shares at $12.0464 per share. The total purchase amount was $1,133,816. Steamboat Capital Partners GP, LLC is the general partner of both funds, and Kiai is its managing member and the managing member of Steamboat Capital Partners, LLC, which has investment discretion over the Master Fund. Kiai may be deemed to have a pecuniary interest in the shares and disclaims beneficial ownership except to that extent. Following the transactions, Kiai indirectly owned 804,221 shares through the Master Fund.
